headlines.title: Cornell University police made drug arrest hours before alleged sexual assault
headlines.description: Cornell University police made a drug-related arrest at a fraternity house 22 hours before a former student alleges she was drugged and sexually assaulted there, according to police records.

headlines.title: ‘It’s not enough to not rape somebody’: How parents are talking to kids about Cornell allegations
headlines.description: Parents are using Jane Doe’s case to talk to their sons about resisting peer pressure and stepping in when something’s wrong, even if it means challenging their friends.

headlines.title: Inside Walmart's push to win fashion shoppers with $25-and-under looks, new bohemian brand
headlines.description: With Target struggling and Amazon's essentials in the mix, Walmart is pushing fashion to gain market share. With new brand Scenario's under-$25 looks, the retailer aims to shift perceptions of "cheap" to chic value. NBC News' Allie Canal reports.

headlines.title: Co-pilot attacker had been banned from flying over his radical views
headlines.description: The Wall Street Journal reports the co-pilot who tried to fly a plane bound for Israel into the ground had been banned from flying by his home country, Oman, over his radical views. Plus, an Israeli official told NBC News investigators discovered the co-pilot had posted on social media that he wanted to kill Jews. NBC News’ Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Global tech policymakers agree to embrace AI in science
headlines.description: The U.S. plans to release a joint statement with 15 other countries describing a shared vision for a “golden age of science” that embraces artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Zach Bryan wears ‘Free Palestine’ shirt at Gillette Stadium concert, weeks after Ed Sheeran tour uproar
headlines.description: Country singer Zach Bryan wore a “Free Palestine” T-shirt during his concert at Gillette Stadium near Boston on Friday night, weeks after stadium’s owner Robert Kraft was accused of pressuring Ed Sheeran to drop his opening act over pro-Palestinian remarks.

headlines.title: A failed execution, and an FBI official steps down: The news quiz
headlines.description: Mosquitoes cause a state of emergency in Florida, a hedge fund billionaire makes a massive donation, and Taylor Swift breaks another record.

headlines.title: Can Democrats Mess With (Republican) Texas?
headlines.description: State Rep. Gina Hinojosa (D-TX) says the economy and jobs are more important than culture issues in the race for Texas Governor

headlines.title: Democrats regain ground on voter registration in key states after steep post-2024 drops
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk analysis of voter file data in seven states found that Democrats managed to reverse or slow their registration decline over the past year.

headlines.title: Mike Tomlin gives fans a glimpse inside the Minecraft city he spent 12 years building
headlines.description: For 12 years, the former Pittsburgh Steelers coach has been devoted to building a single map in the video game. On Wednesday, he showed it off for the first time.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
